## Language

{{< include /components/_lang.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
import {
  loadNotebookContent,
  readNotebookConfig,
} from "/helpers/notebook.js";

notebookConfig = readNotebookConfig()

notebookContent = await loadNotebookContent(notebookConfig)

nbText = notebookContent.text[language.key] ?? notebookContent.text.en

sections = notebookContent.sections[language.key] ?? notebookContent.sections.en

nbTitle = notebookConfig.title?.[language.key] ??
  notebookConfig.title?.en ??
  notebookConfig.id

tmpl = (template, values) =>
  Lang.reduceReplaceTemplateItems(
    template,
    Object.entries(values).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value })),
  )
```

```{ojs}
{
  Lang.applyTranslations({
    sections,
    md,
    lang: language.key,
    headings: {
      ...(nbText.headings ?? {}),
      contributions: _lang(general_translations.contributors),
      appendix: _lang(general_translations.appendix),
    },
  });
}
```
